nodes.label: trader/strategy/blend.py
nodes.rationale: Every strategy entered the orchestrator sum at a flat weight, so a mechanism printing PF 1.8 counted exactly as much as one limping at 0.9. Each factor is bounded to [0.5, 1.5] so neither alone pins the product at the ceiling and loses the ordering inside the set.
